info.name: MustPayroll fixed — API Testing and UI Setup
info.description: For the fixed application only. Import into Postman and keep baseUrl at http://127.0.0.1:4176. Send requests individually; no scripts or runner are required. Each create request returns payrollDatasetId, the internal identifier for an isolated test dataset. Later API requests and the browser link use that identifier; the interface provides no dataset-management controls. After creating records, copy the returned payrollDatasetId into the collection variable payrollDatasetId and Save. TC03 and TC04 are the two API cases. PAY-001/PAY-003 and PAY-002 reproduce the three existing UI defects; UI setup only prepares the six browser cases. Use the other build’s own collection for its checks.

variable.description: The fixed service address: http://127.0.0.1:4176. GET {{baseUrl}}/api/health must identify this build.
Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId returned by POST {{baseUrl}}/api/payroll-datasets. Save before subsequent requests; create a new test dataset for each case.

request.description: Expected: 200 OK, application MustPayroll, build.variant fixed at port 4176. Retain build.id. Stop if this is not the fixed application.

item.name: UI setup only
item.description: Create starting records for the six browser cases. These requests do not execute payroll and are not extra API test cases.

item.name: TC01 | Earnings entry and approval
item.description: Create an empty earning list, then record seven earnings in the browser. Use Approve earnings and Reject earnings to establish TC01’s final statuses before processing payroll.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: TC02 | Period boundaries
item.description: Create the four approved earnings around the opening and closing Monday boundaries. Save the returned payrollDatasetId and open {{baseUrl}}/pay-runs?payrollDatasetId={{payrollDatasetId}} in the browser, replacing both placeholders. Follow TC02 in functional-test-suite.md; these requests only prepare its data.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: TC05 | Payment failure
item.description: Create Amara’s approved $1,500 earning, then send request 2 once to fail the next payment attempt. Save payrollDatasetId and open {{baseUrl}}/pay-runs?payrollDatasetId={{payrollDatasetId}} in the browser, replacing both placeholders. Follow TC05 in functional-test-suite.md. Do not arm the failure again before payroll retry.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: 2. Make the first payment attempt fail once

request.description: Expected: 200 OK. Only the next payment attempt fails. Do not send this again before retrying payroll.

item.name: TC06 | Delivery failure
item.description: Create Amara’s approved $1,500 earning, then send request 2 once to fail the next notification attempt. Save payrollDatasetId and open {{baseUrl}}/pay-runs?payrollDatasetId={{payrollDatasetId}} in the browser, replacing both placeholders. Follow TC06 in functional-test-suite.md. Buggy creates no notification work, so the delivery failure is not reached.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: 2. Make the first delivery attempt fail once

request.description: Expected: 200 OK. Only the next notification attempt fails. In buggy, notification work is absent, so this delivery condition is never reached.

item.name: TC07 and TC08 | Normal payment
item.description: Create Amara’s approved $1,500 earning with no failure setup. Save payrollDatasetId and open {{baseUrl}}/pay-runs?payrollDatasetId={{payrollDatasetId}} in the browser, replacing both placeholders. Follow TC07 or TC08 in functional-test-suite.md, creating a new test dataset for each case and build.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: TC03 | UTC period selection
item.description: Manual case. Send requests 1–4 in order. Inspect each response using TC03 in api-test-suite.md. Both builds should pass this timezone rule.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.
Expected: 200 OK. outside.earnedAt becomes 2026-10-04T23:30:00.000Z; inside.earnedAt becomes 2026-10-05T00:00:00.000Z. Only inside is in the selected week.
Expected: 200 OK. Both timestamps explicitly simulate Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 09:00 UTC. This action records local payments; it does not depend on the workstation date.

Expected: 200 OK. Check the normalized earnedAt values, employeePayrollSummaries[].earningIds, approvedTotalCents and recordedPaymentTotalCents. Only inside contributes to one 150000-cent payment. Notification creation is covered separately by TC08.

item.name: TC04 | Duplicate earning import
item.description: Manual case. Send requests 1–4 in order. The initial records already contain earn-001. Reimporting the same ID must not increase the payable amount. Both builds should pass.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.

item.name: 2. Reimport two identical copies of earn-001

request.description: Expected: 200 OK; earnings contains one earn-001, not three; recordedPaymentTotalCents stays 0 before payroll processing.
Expected: 200 OK. Both timestamps explicitly simulate Tuesday 13 October 2026 at 09:00 UTC. This action records local payments; it does not depend on the workstation date.

Expected: 200 OK. Check one earn-001 remains, employeePayrollSummaries[].earningIds contains it once, and one payment records 150000 cents. Approved and recorded totals are both 150000. Notification creation is covered separately by TC08.

item.name: PAY-001 and PAY-003 | Missing notification and duplicate payment
item.description: Alternative HTTP reproduction of two existing defects, not additional assessment cases. PAY-003: steps 1-5 inspect saved notification work and notification-only recovery (TC08). PAY-001: continue through steps 6-7 to inspect payroll retry and payment identity (TC07). Keep the original paymentId. Buggy: no notification, then two payments totaling 300000 cents. Fixed: one payment totaling 150000 cents and its original linked Sent notification.

item.name: 3. Keep the original payment and notification IDs

request.description: Expected: 200 OK. Inspect approvedTotalCents, recordedPaymentTotalCents, employeePayrollSummaries[].earningIds, payments and notifications. Amounts are integer USD cents: 150000 represents $1,500.00. Follow the relevant case or defect comparison; a 200 response alone is not a PASS.
Expected: 200 OK. This action handles existing pending work. It cannot create a missing instruction: buggy remains without notification records. It must never add a payment.

item.name: PAY-002 | Earnings paid without approval
item.description: Alternative HTTP reproduction of TC01, not a new assessment case. The payload contains four approved earnings, one current-period pending bonus, one rejected claim and one next-period pending earning. Approved total is 435000 cents. Buggy pays 510000; fixed pays 435000.

request.description: Expected: 201 Created. Copy the top-level payrollDatasetId from this response into the collection variable payrollDatasetId, then Save. This isolates this case from every earlier payment. Do not reuse an ID from another case or build.
Expected: 200 OK; seven earnings and no payment. Four approved current-period records total 435000 cents. The pending 50,000-cent bonus and rejected 25,000-cent claim must not be paid.
